description: Wallet balance on an EVM chain (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon): native coin plus ERC-20 balances. tokens= takes symbols (USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH) or contract addresses, comma-separated; default is the chain's major stablecoins and WETH. Read live from public RPC. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402, or 12 sats Cashu ecash (NUT-24), or 12 sats over Lightning (L402).
name: evm_balance
